name: Loss of Off-Site Power (LOOP)
description: Off-site grid supply is lost. Reactor coolant pumps and main feedwater pumps de-energise, the turbine and reactor trip, essential buses transfer to the emergency diesel generators, and the plant settles on natural circulation with decay-heat removal.
briefing: You are at ~100% power. At t+20 s the switchyard is lost. Verify automatic protective actions, confirm both diesels pick up the essential buses, and stabilise the plant on decay heat. Acknowledge alarms as they come in.
learning_objectives: Recognise a process (electrical) initiating event versus an instrument fault
Follow the trip cascade: LOOP -> RCP trip -> low-flow reactor trip -> turbine trip
Observe that decay heat persists and must still be removed after shutdown
Confirm emergency diesel generator start and essential bus re-energisation
